project.title: Rollout of Standardised Patient Intake and Admin Workflow
project.objective: Design and roll out a standardised, compliant patient intake and admin workflow across all units to reduce errors and improve coordination between clinical and admin staff.
deliverables: Mapped current patient intake and admin workflows for all units
Standard operating procedure (SOP) for patient intake and basic admin tasks
Unified set of intake and consent forms aligned with policy and legislation
Training materials and quick-reference guides for admin and healthcare assistants
Pilot rollout report with metrics on errors, delays, and staff feedback
Implementation plan for full rollout with timeline and responsibilities
constraints: All forms and workflows must comply with current healthcare legislation and consent requirements
Project must not disrupt critical patient care; changes phased around peak hours
Limited IT changes allowed; focus on process and documentation, not new systems
Training sessions must fit within existing shift patterns and staffing levels
Data protection and confidentiality rules must be strictly followed
Deadline for pilot completion is within the agreed project timebox

risks.risk: Staff resistance to changing established intake routines
risks.mitigation: Involve representatives from each unit in design, collect feedback early, and highlight time-saving benefits.

risks.risk: New forms or SOPs fail compliance or data protection checks
risks.mitigation: Have quality and compliance officer review drafts before pilot; adjust based on their feedback.

risks.risk: Training clashes with staffing needs and leads to understaffed shifts
risks.mitigation: Coordinate schedule with clinic manager and head nurse; offer multiple short sessions and async materials.

risks.risk: Process changes increase patient waiting times during pilot
risks.mitigation: Run pilot in limited time windows, monitor waiting times daily, and adjust steps that add unnecessary handling.

themes.why_relevant: Participants must document and align varied current practices into one clear, repeatable workflow.
New intake and admin steps must respect legislation, consent, and data protection rules.
Admin changes affect nurses and healthcare assistants; coordination avoids friction and errors.
Staff need clear guidance and support to adopt new SOPs without impacting patient care.
Measuring before/after error rates and delays shows whether the new workflow is effective.

backlog.task: Map current patient intake and basic admin workflows for each unit
definition_of_done: Workflows from at least three representative units documented with steps and handoffs
Pain points and variations between units clearly listed
Validated with one healthcare assistant and one nurse per unit

backlog.task: Draft standard patient intake SOP including documentation and consent steps
definition_of_done: SOP covers registration, identification, consent, and basic information capture
Roles and responsibilities for each step are clearly defined
Reviewed and approved by quality and compliance officer

backlog.task: Create unified intake and consent form set aligned with policy
definition_of_done: Draft forms created for adult, older adult, and disability support cases
Forms checked for required legal and consent fields
Data protection officer or delegate signs off on final templates

backlog.task: Design quick-reference checklist for healthcare assistants on new intake routine
definition_of_done: Checklist fits on one page and uses clear, simple language
Includes key safety, consent, and identification checks
Piloted with at least three healthcare assistants and refined based on feedback

backlog.task: Plan and schedule training sessions across shifts
definition_of_done: Training calendar agreed with clinic manager and head nurse
At least 80% of target staff have a scheduled slot
Async materials shared for those who cannot attend live

backlog.task: Deliver pilot training and collect staff feedback
definition_of_done: At least two live sessions delivered
Attendance recorded and questions captured
Summary of feedback and improvement suggestions documented

backlog.task: Run a two-week pilot of the new intake workflow in selected unit
definition_of_done: Pilot start and end dates confirmed with unit leadership
Daily check-ins with unit contact completed
No critical incidents linked to the new workflow reported

backlog.task: Monitor and report on errors, delays, and rework during pilot
definition_of_done: Baseline metrics for errors and delays collected from previous period
Pilot metrics tracked and compared to baseline
Pilot report with findings and recommendations shared with stakeholders

backlog.task: Update SOPs, forms, and checklists based on pilot results
definition_of_done: Change log created with all adjustments and rationale
Revised documents approved by quality and compliance officer
Version control and distribution plan updated

backlog.task: Prepare full rollout implementation plan for all units
definition_of_done: Rollout phases, owners, and dates defined
Risks and mitigation actions listed
Plan validated with clinic manager and head nurse

backlog.task: Create communication pack for staff about the new workflow
definition_of_done: Short announcement message drafted for internal channels
FAQ with top 10 expected questions prepared
Communication reviewed by clinic manager

backlog.task: Set up simple monitoring routine post-rollout
definition_of_done: Monthly checklist for monitoring created
Responsibility for data collection assigned
First three months’ review dates scheduled

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current-state workflows and confirm scope for standardisation
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to share how intake and admin tasks currently run in their units.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on which units and intake scenarios are in scope for the first standardisation wave.
Confirm the level of detail required in the current-state workflow maps (A1, T1).

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review and finalise the draft standard intake SOP and forms
threads_plan.trigger: Post first draft of SOP and form templates for async review and comments.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the core steps and responsibilities in the Standard Patient Intake SOP (A2, T2).
Select the final versions of intake and consent forms to use in the pilot (A3, T3).

threads_plan.thread_goal: Lock training approach, materials, and schedule for the pilot
threads_plan.trigger: Share draft training deck, checklist, and proposed training calendar for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the training format (live vs async mix) and final training materials (A4, A5, T4, T6).
Confirm the training schedule and target attendance for the pilot unit (T5).

threads_plan.thread_goal: Coordinate the pilot run and daily issue handling
threads_plan.trigger: Announcement that the pilot is starting in the selected unit with dates and expectations.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Confirm the exact pilot start and end dates and the unit(s) participating (T7).

threads_plan.thread_goal: Review pilot results and agree on adjustments and rollout plan
threads_plan.trigger: Post the pilot evaluation report and invite comments on proposed changes and rollout phases.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the final adjusted SOP and forms plus the full rollout implementation plan (A2, A3, A7, T9, T10, T12).

channel_rituals: Daily short async check-in during pilot with quick status and blockers
Twice-weekly planning/update thread on tasks and deadlines
End-of-pilot retrospective thread focusing on what to keep, change, or drop
Pre-rollout readiness check thread to confirm training, materials, and support
Monthly post-rollout monitoring update summarising metrics and issues
